name: Crossroads Supply Crate
summary: At the Crossroads, a raided caravan has left the settlement short of food, tools, and necessities. Stolen provisions now lie scattered among Razormane camps in the Barrens.

sections.title: Plundered Provisions
sections.body: Razormane quilboar raided a caravan bound for the Crossroads and carried its supplies into nearby camps. The crates lie among underbrush and dirt dens. Thork, the settlement's commander, seeks their return before the outpost runs dangerously low on food, tools, and necessities.

faq.answer: The crates hold food, tools, and other provisions meant for the Horde settlement of the Crossroads. Razormane quilboar scattered them after raiding a supply caravan on the Barrens roads.
Razormane quilboar attacked the caravan and hauled the crates to their nearby thorned camps to feast and hoard the spoils.

faq.q: Who is looking for these crates?
faq.answer: Thork, an orc officer stationed at the Crossroads, seeks the stolen crates to keep the garrison and local inhabitants supplied.
The crates lie scattered among Razormane quilboar camps in the surrounding Barrens.

angles.text: The Crossroads links Durotar, Mulgore, and the northern wildlands. Its supplies help protect Horde travel and logistics across Kalimdor.
